title: Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: If a player dies while having this item in their in-raid quest inventory, it is returned back to them via in-game mail.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Ticket if the player did not refuse to work with Mr. Kerman, assisted him with finding evidence and then continued searching.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: On the desk under the window in the armory inside the armory building on Terminal. Note: Only spawns if the player brought it into the raid.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - This Secure container Alpha is the same container that appears in Battlestate Games The Raid movie.
